purpose: Stronger existing control character; recording match is mixed, not universal realism qualification.

isolated_weighted_picking.normalization: Stereo average power, each note divided by its own0–500ms stereoRMS². WAVs match that RMS to0.035. Fixed note-on windows; no onset/time shift. Default Spruce/Original/Touch.58/Pluck.28/Body.82/Stereo.62, same seed per fresh engine.

combined_weighted_controls.normalization: Stereo average power, each note divided by its own0–500ms stereoRMS². WAVs match that RMS to0.035. Fixed note-on windows; no onset/time shift. Default Spruce/Original/Touch.58/Pluck.28/Body.82/Stereo.62, same seed per fresh engine.

extreme_initialized_notes.scope: Initialized vertical-loop state, not radiated audio or perceptual qualification. Material 0=nylon/1=steel; style 0=Finger/1=Pick/2=Thumb; position_case 0=panel0/1=panel1/2=MPE0/3=MPE1. Eight sampled velocities, not all 127 velocities. All MIDI pitches 40–84 inclusive.
extreme_initialized_notes.MPE_note: The engine preserves its RNG sequence across reset, so sequential styles intentionally draw different take offsets. This probe compares the same seeded iteration between builds, not different styles with unequal RNG state. Existing native MPE tests use fresh engines for exact between-style identity.

recorded_training.protocol:
Fixed training-only comparison for the picking/body feedback change.

Uses the existing Yamaha/Walden nine training pitches, original file selection,
feature extractor, weights, MIDI velocity and Auditorium settings. No fitting,
development pitches or protected corpus. Two immutable renderer snapshots.

initial_native_run.status: Four suites passed; Engine failed eight obsolete radiation-only Shape assertions. Revised test semantics retain wood equality/fade coverage; final Engine rerun passes.

audition.normalization: Each note stereo RMS over first 500 ms is 0.035. Original first 800 ms retained, final 30 ms faded. No onset alignment. 200 ms inter-note gaps, additional 500 ms between option groups. Same controls, fresh note engine/seed per clip. StereoMic / Original / Spruce; Shape montage Finger v91; Picking montage Auditorium v127.
